name: Processed Hay Products
summary: The full-game store describes hay pulp, compressed bales, eco bricks, hay paper and pellets. Use this overview to recognise the product families; it is not a list of everything unlocked in the demo.

data.pulp: A processed hay product named by the store. Read the recipe and required equipment in your current game before reserving a production line for it.
data.bales: Compressed hay is listed among the product families, and the store mentions balers. Do not equate a compressed bale with the Silo’s hay wad when checking stored needles.
data.bricks: Eco bricks are named in the store. Separately, Demo V8 added a BRICKS resource label to the Pellet Disc Machine; that label alone does not give its complete recipe.
data.paper: Hay paper and paper machines appear in the full-game description. Check that the relevant machinery is available in your build before planning around paper production.
data.pellets: Pellets are a listed product family. The Pellet Disc Machine is also named in official demo notes, but those notes do not confirm every input, output quantity or selling value.
data.check: The developer explains that hay products can contain needles. Keep scanning in the route as processing expands. Use in-game recipes and prices for a budget; there is no confirmed universal profit ranking here.

sources.label: Developer reply and player reports · September 13, 2026
